description: OP Mainnet fee reference. A static snapshot captured 2026-11-14, no input: the fee model mechanics (EIP-1559 execution, the Ecotone L1 data fee formula with the documented 5227 and 1014213 scalars, the Isthmus operator fee) and the observed typical cost ranges from the 2026 trackers, the capture date printed on every card. The L1 data fee rides live Ethereum prices, so the card carries formulas and observed ranges, never fabricated totals. Price: $0.01 per call, paid in USDC on Base mainnet over x402; an unpaid call answers HTTP 402 with the exact machine-readable payment terms.
name: optimism-fee-snapshot
